audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for covenant ratification, blood of covenant, elders seeing Divine, sapphire pavement, Moses on mountain forty days.

verses.restored: And to Moses he said, Come up to YHWH, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy elders of Israel, and you shall worship from afar.

familiar.text: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD—you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders—and you are to worship at a distance.

original.text: וְאֶל מֹשֶׁ֨ה אָמַ֜ר עֲלֵ֣ה אֶל יְהוָ֗ה אַתָּה֙ וְאַהֲרֹן֙ נָדָ֣ב וַאֲבִיה֔וּא וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים מִזִּקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם מֵרָחֹֽק

verses.restored: Moses alone shall come near to YHWH, but they shall not come near, and the people shall not go up with him.

familiar.text: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.

modern.text: Moses alone shall approach the LORD, but the others must not come near. And the people may not go up with him.”

original.text: וְנִגַּ֨שׁ מֹשֶׁ֤ה לְבַדּוֹ֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וְהֵ֖ם לֹ֣א יִגָּ֑שׁוּ וְהָעָ֕ם לֹ֥א יַעֲל֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Moses came and recounted to the people all words of YHWH and all judgments/ordinances; all the people answered with one voice and said, All the words that YHWH has spoken we will do.

familiar.text: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.

modern.text: When Moses came and told the people all the words and ordinances of the LORD, they all responded with one voice: “All the words that the LORD has spoken, we will do.”

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיְסַפֵּ֤ר לָעָם֙ אֵ֚ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת כָּל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים וַיַּ֨עַן כָּל הָעָ֜ם ק֤וֹל אֶחָד֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כָּל הַדְּבָרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶֽׂה

verses.restored: Moses wrote all words of YHWH. He rose early in morning and built altar under mountain and twelve standing-stones for twelve tribes of Israel.

familiar.text: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

modern.text: And Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD. Early the next morning he got up and built an altar at the base of the mountain, along with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

original.text: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֵ֚ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֣ם בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבֵּ֖חַ תַּ֣חַת הָהָ֑ר וּשְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ מַצֵּבָ֔ה לִשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: He sent young men of children of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of bulls to YHWH.

familiar.text: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD.

modern.text: Then he sent out some young men of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶֽת נַעֲרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּֽעֲל֖וּ עֹלֹ֑ת וַֽיִּזְבְּח֞וּ זְבָחִ֧ים שְׁלָמִ֛ים לַיהוָ֖ה פָּרִֽים

verses.restored: Moses took half the blood/life and put in basins, and half the blood/life he dashed against altar.

familiar.text: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

modern.text: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he sprinkled on the altar.

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ חֲצִ֣י הַדָּ֔ם וַיָּ֖שֶׂם בָּאַגָּנֹ֑ת וַחֲצִ֣י הַדָּ֔ם זָרַ֖ק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ

verses.restored: He took scroll of covenant and read in ears of people; they said, All that YHWH has spoken we will do and we will hear/listen.

familiar.text: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.

modern.text: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people, who replied, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.”

original.text: וַיִּקַּח֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַבְּרִ֔ית וַיִּקְרָ֖א בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶׂ֥ה וְנִשְׁמָֽע

verses.restored: Moses took the blood/life and sprinkled upon the people and said, Look, blood/life of covenant that YHWH cut with you concerning all these words.

familiar.text: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.

modern.text: So Moses took the blood, sprinkled it on the people, and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת הַדָּ֔ם וַיִּזְרֹ֖ק עַל הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֤ה דַֽם הַבְּרִית֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם עַ֥ל כָּל הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה

verses.restored: Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy elders of Israel went up.

familiar.text: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

modern.text: Then Moses went up with Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֑ן נָדָב֙ וַאֲבִיה֔וּא וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים מִזִּקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: They saw Divine of Israel, and under his feet like work of sapphire brick, and like substance of heavens for purity.

familiar.text: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.

modern.text: and they saw the God of Israel. Under His feet was a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.

original.text: וַיִּרְא֕וּ אֵ֖ת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְתַ֣חַת רַגְלָ֗יו כְּמַעֲשֵׂה֙ לִבְנַ֣ת הַסַּפִּ֔יר וּכְעֶ֥צֶם הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָטֹֽהַר

verses.restored: Against nobles of children of Israel he did not send his hand; they beheld the Divine, and they ate and drank.

familiar.text: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.

modern.text: But God did not lay His hand on the nobles of Israel; they saw Him, and they ate and drank. Moses on the Mountain

original.text: וְאֶל אֲצִילֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֖ח יָד֑וֹ וַֽיֶּחֱזוּ֙ אֶת הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֹּאכְל֖וּ וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Come up to me on mountain and be there, and I will give you tablets of stone, Torah/instruction and command that I wrote, to teach them.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to Me on the mountain and stay here, so that I may give you the tablets of stone, with the law and commandments I have written for their instruction.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה עֲלֵ֥ה אֵלַ֛י הָהָ֖רָה וֶהְיֵה שָׁ֑ם וְאֶתְּנָ֨ה לְךָ֜ אֶת לֻחֹ֣ת הָאֶ֗בֶן וְהַתּוֹרָה֙ וְהַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּתַ֖בְתִּי לְהוֹרֹתָֽם

verses.restored: Moses rose, and Joshua his attendant; Moses went up to mountain of the Divine.

familiar.text: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.

modern.text: So Moses set out with Joshua his attendant and went up on the mountain of God.

original.text: וַיָּ֣קָם מֹשֶׁ֔ה וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ מְשָׁרְת֑וֹ וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל הַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: To the elders he said, Sit for us here until we return to you. Look, Aaron and Hur are with you; whoever has matters, let him approach them.

familiar.text: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.

modern.text: And he said to the elders, “Wait here for us until we return to you. Aaron and Hur are here with you. Whoever has a dispute can go to them.”

original.text: וְאֶל הַזְּקֵנִ֤ים אָמַר֙ שְׁבוּ לָ֣נוּ בָזֶ֔ה עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר נָשׁ֖וּב אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֨ה אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְחוּר֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם מִי בַ֥עַל דְּבָרִ֖ים יִגַּ֥שׁ אֲלֵהֶֽם

verses.restored: Moses went up to mountain, and cloud covered the mountain.

familiar.text: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.

modern.text: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it,

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל הָהָ֑ר וַיְכַ֥ס הֶעָנָ֖ן אֶת הָהָֽר

verses.restored: Glory of YHWH dwelt upon Mount Sinai, and cloud covered it six days; on seventh day he called to Moses from midst of cloud.

familiar.text: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

modern.text: and the glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered it, and on the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from within the cloud.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁכֹּ֤ן כְּבוֹד יְהוָה֙ עַל הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וַיְכַסֵּ֥הוּ הֶעָנָ֖ן שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָ֧א אֶל מֹשֶׁ֛ה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י מִתּ֥וֹךְ הֶעָנָֽן

verses.restored: Appearance of glory of YHWH was like consuming fire on top of mountain before eyes of children of Israel.

familiar.text: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.

modern.text: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like a consuming fire on the mountaintop in the eyes of the Israelites.

original.text: וּמַרְאֵה֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה כְּאֵ֥שׁ אֹכֶ֖לֶת בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר לְעֵינֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Moses came into midst of cloud and went up mountain; Moses was on mountain forty days and forty nights.

familiar.text: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.

modern.text: Moses entered the cloud as he went up on the mountain, and he remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הֶעָנָ֖ן וַיַּ֣עַל אֶל הָהָ֑ר וַיְהִ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ בָּהָ֔ר אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָֽיְלָה

translation_notes: Covenant ratification includes words spoken, words written, altar, twelve stones, offerings, blood/life, and people's response.
'We will do and we will hear/listen' preserves na'aseh venishma resonance.
Seeing Divine and eating/drinking is extraordinary covenant fellowship; preserve without over-systematizing.
Sapphire brick/pavement echoes Egypt brick language transformed into heavenly purity imagery.
safety_note: Blood of covenant is ancient ritual life-symbolism and must not be sensationalized. Covenant is ratified around liberation, instruction, shared response, and fellowship before Divine.
